name: Historic Town of Sukhothai and Associated Historic Towns
description: In northern Thailand, three ruined cities (Sukhothai, Si Satchanalai and Kamphaeng Phet) preserve the heart of the first Thai kingdom, which flourished in the 13th and 14th centuries. Each is now a quiet historical park where you can wander among old temple remains and monuments. They show the birth of Thai architecture and the blended "Sukhothai style.
